load_audio_to_48khz: load an audio file from a path and resample it to 48kHz using torchaudio
pad_spectrogram: pad a spectrogram tensor to a multiple of 64 along the time dimension with reflection padding
normalize_noisy_audio: normalize noisy audio tensors by their maximum absolute value to prevent NaN values
compute_mean_confidence_interval: compute the mean and confidence interval of a NumPy array using scipy statistics
detect_audio_type_from_filename: detect whether an audio file is music, sound, or speech based on its filename prefix
